text: Bitcoin's modest 2% gain outpacing Ethereum's 1.3% reflects a flight to perceived safety, reinforced by rising Bitcoin dominance at 56.5%. Fear & Greed remains depressed at 31 despite slight weekly improvement, suggesting investors are cautiously positioning rather than committing capital, as evidenced by subdued 24-hour volume of $54B. Altcoins show minimal momentum—BNB flat and SOL barely holding—pointing to a market waiting for clearer directional conviction.
